delete.body: This can't be undone. Agents with run history can only be disabled.

setOrch.body: All messages of tenants without their own Orchestrator will go through this agent.

agents.truncated: Showing the first 200 agents. Use search to filter on the server.

overwrite.body: v{n} will be replaced by your version (becoming v{next}).

orch.title: Orchestrator
orch.subtitle: The agent that receives every message and delegates to a specialist agent, answers itself, or asks back. Messages starting with @agent go straight to that agent.
orch.slow: Slow: each decision starts the CLI for a few seconds and takes a subscription slot. With an API key, prefer an llm runtime with a cheap model.

tenants.empty: No tenant has its own Orchestrator yet.
tenants.note: The Hub uses the tenant's own Orchestrator first, otherwise the default.

delete.body: The tenant will go back to the default.
